title: Henry Morrison Flagler Museum

services.name: Group Tours
services.desc: (Scroll down for Private Tour information) Group Tours are available Tuesday through Sunday for organized groups consisting of a minimium 20, and maximum of 50, visitors. Group Tours include a Docent-led tour of the first floor of Whitehall and last about 45 minutes. In addition to a Docent-led tour of the first floor, the Flagler Museum offers three options for touring the second floor of Whitehall and the Flagler Kenan Pavilion and Railcar No. 91: Self-guide Brochures and Audio Tours in English, Spanish, German, French, and Portuguese; and the Flagler Museum Tour app in English, Spanish, and French.
